description: Ministry of  City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the lands in Kesbewa D/S Division, Katana, Kandy and Polgahawela for Water Supply Projects
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains three separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific land parcels for water infrastructure projects (pumphouse construction, water tower construction, and service reservoir/access road construction). The content includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels, their boundaries, locations, and claimants' information, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). While a government minister is named, the core content focuses on land acquisition rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
